title: MUSE: Dependency-Aware Adaptation of a Frozen Vision Backbone for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.24441v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multivariate time-series forecasting is essential to many real-world applications. Recent large vision models (LVMs) offer a promising paradigm by transferring cross-domain visual priors to time-series forecasting. However, existing LVM-based methods face two key challenges: balancing independent visual representation spaces with cross-variable dependency modeling, and adapting vision backbones pretrained on natural images to the distinct temporal semantics of time-series images. To address these challenges, we propose MUSE, a dependency-aware adaptation framework built on a fully frozen pretrained MAE. First, the Variable Context Refinement Module (VCR) aggregates shared temporal information within each variable and models cross-variable contextual dependencies while preserving independent visual spaces. translated_title: MUSE：面向多变量时间序列预测的冻结视觉骨干网络的依赖感知适配
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列预测对许多现实世界应用至关重要。近期的大型视觉模型（LVMs）通过将跨领域的视觉先验迁移到时间序列预测中，提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，现有的基于LVM的方法面临两个关键挑战：如何平衡独立的视觉表示空间与跨变量依赖建模，以及如何将在自然图像上预训练的视觉骨干网络适配到时间序列图像独特的时间语义中。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了MUSE，一个建立在完全冻结的预训练MAE之上的依赖感知适配框架。首先，变量上下文精炼模块（VCR）在每个变量内部聚合共享的时间信息，并建模跨变量的上下文依赖，同时保持独立的视觉空间。其次，时间-周期精炼模块（TPR）在不同的编码器深度执行轻量级精炼，并显式建模（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出MUSE框架，在完全冻结的预训练MAE上通过变量上下文精炼模块（VCR）建模跨变量依赖并保持独立视觉空间，同时利用时间-周期精炼模块（TPR）适配时间序列的时间语义，从而提升多变量时间序列预测性能。
en_tdlr: MUSE is a dependency-aware adaptation framework built on a fully frozen pretrained MAE, which uses a Variable Context Refinement module to model cross-variable dependencies while preserving independent visual spaces, and a Temporal-Periodic Refinement module to adapt to the temporal semantics of time-series images for improved multivariate time-series forecasting.
